USURER-DEBT.title: Debt
USURER-DEBT.description: Financial leverage on the player. At the end of your turn, increases by [blue]+20%[/blue] Interest (rounded up), then if you are [gold]Over-Leveraged[/gold] ([blue]10+[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold]), you take [blue]Debt / 5[/blue] unpowered Installment damage.
USURER-BORROW.title: Borrow
USURER-BORROW.description: Gain the specified amount of [gold]Debt[/gold] to fuel undercosted cards and trigger [gold]Over-Leveraged[/gold] effects.
USURER-REPAY.title: Repay
USURER-REPAY.description: Remove up to the specified amount of [gold]Debt[/gold]. Many cards grant bonus [gold]Block[/gold] or rewards based on the exact [gold]Debt[/gold] repaid.
USURER-OVER_LEVERAGED.title: Over-Leveraged
USURER-OVER_LEVERAGED.description: Active while you have [blue]10[/blue] or more [gold]Debt[/gold]. Empowers high-leverage cards and relics, but triggers turn-end Installment payments unless paused by [gold]Moratorium[/gold].
USURER-LIEN.title: Lien
USURER-LIEN.description: Collateral debuff on an enemy. Whenever hit by an Attack, the enemy takes damage equal to its [gold]Lien[/gold] and you [gold]Repay[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold].
USURER-FORECLOSE.title: Foreclose
USURER-FORECLOSE.description: Consume all [gold]Lien[/gold] stacks on an enemy to deal massive burst damage per stack and [gold]Repay[/gold] [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Debt[/gold] per stack.
USURER-MORATORIUM.title: Moratorium
USURER-MORATORIUM.description: Pauses turn-end [gold]Debt[/gold] Interest (+20%) and Installment damage for [blue]1[/blue] turn per stack.
